items.briefing:
A critical vulnerability has been discovered in GitLab that puts software supply chains at serious risk. If your organisation uses GitLab for managing code or projects, ensure it is updated immediately, as attackers could exploit this flaw to compromise systems broadly. Separately, the Russian-linked hacking group Sandworm has been found chaining together Cisco router vulnerabilities to deploy malware — a reminder to keep all network equipment patched and up to date.

For Microsoft 365 users, new insider-risk management tools are being expanded, which may help Australian organisations better detect unusual behaviour from within their own teams.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT team today that GitLab and any Cisco network devices are running the latest available security updates.

featured.title: Proofpoint expands insider-risk tools to Microsoft 365
featured.summary: Investigators will get a fuller audit trail as the software links Microsoft 365 activity and AI prompts with emails, files and logs.
